title: Threat Defense Consultant, Mandiant

sections.minimum_qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
- 5 years of experience in security analysis, intelligence, customer success or a similar field in cyber security.
- Experience in managing internal or external customer-facing projects, and working with cross-functional teams.
sections.preferred_qualifications:
- Master’s degree in Business, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering or Applied Science, or a related field.
- 5 years of cyber threat intelligence analysis experience.
- 5 years of experience in responding to security problems in aimed environments, security alerts, analysis and response.
- Demonstrated experience in cloud security delivered within the context of customer facing roles.
sections.about:
The Google Cloud Consulting Professional Services team guides customers through the moments that matter most in their cloud journey to help businesses thrive. We help customers transform and evolve their business through the use of Google’s global network, web-scale data centers, and software infrastructure. As part of an innovative team in this rapidly growing business, you will help shape the future of businesses of all sizes and use technology to connect with customers, employees, and partners.
Our mission is to help clients overcome their toughest technical challenges and strengthen their security. We do this by providing security expertise and strategic advisory for Google SecOps and other security solutions. We're committed to building strong partnerships, understanding each client's unique needs, and consistently exceeding expectations through technical excellence, proactive security, and unwavering integrity.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
US: $152000 - $221000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits
Learn more about benefits at Google.
sections.responsibilities:
- Build and maintain strong customer relationships, focused on security, understanding their needs and challenges.
- Deliver insightful technical briefings on the latest security trends, including threat intelligence and malware analysis.
- Solve intricate technical challenges with ambiguous requirements, developing innovative and effective solutions.
- Provide timely and effective support for critical incidents and customer issues outside of standard business hours.
- Partner with various teams and stakeholders across departments to achieve shared goals.
